added_failures_note: the reviewed node's write paths contain no test file, so it was not armed: its manifest records baseline_suite and after_suite as absent and no such gate logs exist in its run directory, so there were no added failures to derive and the zero is an unarmed absence rather than a measured zero.

findings.text: follow-on: the apply's whole spend went to electron_temperature_at_separatrix and gap_at_outboard_midplane, two names outside the family, and the family's own members were never processed (0/1 accepted), so the node's guard 'touch no name outside the family' was not met and the re-measure produced no family-side evidence; the record reports this honestly, so it is a coordinator decision rather than a defect in the change.

follow-on: the record_cost docstring says the cost is read 'against the exact run ids the apply's own summary reported', but the apply was run without --json so no summary exists and the record's own run_ids_source at shc-locus-remeasure-rerun.json:53 says the id was operator-named; the docstring contradicts the record the brief asked to make agree with the code.

follow-on: aggregate_calls_per_phase is landed with no test that exercises it, and tests/standard_names/test_cost_graph_ops.py:298-360 covers only its spend siblings, so a wrong call count would pass every recorded gate and be written into the record unchallenged.

follow-on: POSITIVE_CONTROL_EXPECTED is declared at line 45 and recorded as positive_control_expected, but the observed match count is compared to it nowhere, so a roster search that silently matched nothing would still let the fragment assert 'a zero member count is a real absence' at shc-locus-remeasure-rerun.html:11.

follow-on: the reset detector requires a doc-stage change as well as a score falling to null, so a member whose documentation score disappears while its stage stays the same is reported in no category and the fragment's 'Members reset back into the pipeline: none' can hide a regression.

follow-on: record_cost stores cost.run_ids from the same entry.run_ids the record already carries, so the gate's assertion that the two are equal moves with its own input and cannot detect a cost read selected on a wrong or prefix-matched run id.
